        "Every hunk in all 22 owned paths was read, including the shared unit-test head and the large iTIP transport rewrite. Replacing those calls is not one uniform severity-only change.",
        "Formerly critical guards remain fatal but now often use ordinary Error instead of Components.Exception: occurrence/proxy state, provider registration, required calendar, storage initialization, parent-item updates and table definitions. Pref id !== null becomes a falsy-id guard. These are scoped type and input-contract changes; no universal caller compatibility is inferred.",
        "Owned passwordManagerSave is async, so its new missing-input errors reject; owned get/remove are synchronous and throw. The accepted helpers are all async after later migration. Saving still suppresses only caught NS_ERROR_ABORT and logs other caught failures; guards before the try are not swallowed there. The directory helper removes a nonfatal log followed by rethrow, so it preserves propagation of the directory-creation exception while dropping that diagnostic.",
        "Composite modify/delete now explicitly reject absent calendars or calendar == this, then delegate to the item's actual calendar. Review caught an intermediate != condition, and the owned/fixed accepted source uses the corrected == guard. This is failure-predicate inversion during assertion conversion, not a new ban on ordinary equality or a generic rule.",

Its caller removes the if(mailFile) wrapper: failure now propagates through _sendXpcomMail/sendItems and the selected outgoing helper, while normal return proceeds to sendMessageFile.
